review.official:
A member of the
Karlan Trade Co. LTD
born in
Kjerag
. Matterhorn is part of the cooperation agreement between the Karlan Trade Co. and
Rhodes Island
, but he also helps carry out missions for the latter as well.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this Operator is believed to be non-infected.

[Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 0% 
Operator shows no signs of infection at this time.

[Blood Crystal Density] 0.12u/L 
This Operator has rarely come into contact with Originium.

Since he was young, Matterhorn was trained to be SilverAsh's bodyguard. His father and grandfather were honorable guards for SilverAsh's family. Naturally, this became his goal, as well. However, unlike military training during his father's time, he still had the opportunity to study other subjects. Almost subconsciously, he chose cooking.

Compared to foreign nations that are rich in resources, Kjerag has very few edible varieties of plants and animals. Even a wealthy family like SilverAsh's usually only eats plain meals. However, once Matterhorn became a cook, everything changed. His mastery of the art of cooking is awe-inspiring. With just a handful of Kjerag ingredients, he can craft culinary delicacies untasted by native Kjerags. It's no wonder that the politicians of Kjerag used to hold meetings at the government's reception hall, but now they only want to meet at SilverAsh's home. The power of food is truly something to behold.

After coming to Rhodes Island, Matterhorn's combat frequency and intensity have increased substantially. His equipment, especially his shield, are in constant need of repair. Matterhorn knows some ways to perform simple repairs in the heat of battle, but thorough maintenance requires the skills of an artisan. Upon being given a recommendation, Matterhorn met Vulcan. Surprised by each other's abilities, they quickly established a long-term relationship: Vulcan maintains Matterhorn's equipment while Matterhorn provides renumeration. When they have free time, they exchange culinary recipes and occasionally share meals together. They are a good example of what close friends should be.

Matterhorn's ancestors were born in the norther region of Kjerag where the environment is harsh and people fight against nature day after day. To ensure the survival of the others, when northern Kjerags go out to fight, they are considered dead. This conviction has resulted in future generations of brave warriors like Matterhorn.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: I've moved your belongings where you wanted. No worries, it wasn't heavy.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: The shield is a symbol of a steadfast guardian.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: I've been responsible for protecting Young Master SilverAsh... I mean, Master SilverAsh... ever since he was young.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: It's not exactly polite to talk about Miss Enya behind her back, but... *sigh* I do pity Miss Enya for what she has suffered. She really deserves a better life.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: If my shield gets damaged, I should take it to the artisan called Vulcan for repairs. Is that correct?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: This is far beyond my expectation. That artisan is truly skilled. I need to thank her properly.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Life at Rhodes Island is fun. The Snow Realm is rather bland in comparison.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Master did send me to protect Ensia. But I honestly don't think she's the type who would sit there and ask to be protected.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I am slowly starting to understand why Master SilverAsh holds you in such high regard. Doctor, from this day, feel free to command me as your shield.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Sometimes, I suddenly start missing my life in the Snow Realm.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Ally, I salute you in true Snow Realm fashion. My codename is Matterhorn, and I am one of the guards dispatched here by Master SilverAsh.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: You have my gratitude.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Thank you for the approval, Doctor. I am greatly flattered.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: I will not step back, not even if this shield shatters the very next second. Not because of my loyalty, but because of my conviction.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: At your service.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I am honored.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I shall protect the team.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: All is ready.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: I shall be your vanguard.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: My shield is ready.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Hm!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Hoo-yah!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Retribution!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: I'm not here just for show!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: With my conviction, I shall bring any monster to its knees!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: You don't have what it takes!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: I wasn't even giving my all!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Their strikes can barely tickle me.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'll pull off a perfect victory next time for you, I promise.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: I should not have taken the enemies lightly. Now I pay the price.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Very nice room, this one. Furnished tastefully, with a peaceful atmosphere.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Mhmm.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: This is my signature dish. How do you like it?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: It's only natural for a guardian to keep his eyes peeled on New Year's day. Troubles do not shy away from celebration days. Rather, they are more likely to jump on people when they let their guard down. Rhodes Island is a comparatively safe place, but you must not lower your defense, Doctor. Happy new year.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good day, Doctor.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: It's your birthday, Doctor, isn't it? No need to worry, for I dare not forget the date. It's just the gift I prepared... I'm really not sure if you are going to appreciate it... So please, Doctor, do me a favor and open it after I leave. Thank you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I'm actually not familiar with what lies outside the Snow Realm, since most of my job was to simply perform the duties my master has entrusted to me. I need to broaden my horizon. Even though I'm no more than a guardian, I need to learn more and see more.
